consequence.statement: This is a fix to istioctl analyze diagnostics: the IST0145 error no longer appears for a wildcard host combined with a specific subdomain. Nothing needs to be done during the upgrade.

assertion.statement: istioctl analyze no longer reports an IST0145 error when a wildcard host is used together with a specific subdomain.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence does not say which resource kinds or fields lead to the IST0145 report. Whether someone runs istioctl analyze is not something configuration can show, so no predicate can express exposure.
